title: Salsa Beginners 1 - Salsa Basic Step for the Absolute Beginner - Detailed explanation

method.teacher_system: The teacher breaks down the basic salsa step into small footwork counts without music, demonstrates from multiple angles including front and side views, and finally puts it together with music.

practices.what: The teacher introduces step number one, stepping forward with the left foot and back with the right foot slowly.
The teacher adds the second part of the basic step, stepping back with the right foot and transferring weight.
The teacher combines both parts of the basic step together slowly without music.
The teacher demonstrates the step from the side view while giving tips on making small steps.
The teacher leads the combined basic step along with live music accompaniment, practising repetitively.

feelings.response: The teacher explains that keeping hands centered prevents the learner from looking bored and helps their body energy flow.

moments.says: The teacher introduces the first basic salsa step, emphasizing its importance for beginners.
The teacher advises the learner to take small steps, keep their hands centered, and avoid bouncing.
The teacher encourages the learner to practice the step again and again if they find it difficult.

mentor.what_stays: The teacher leaves the learner feeling capable and encouraged to master the basic steps through repetition.

method.limits: The video does not show partner holds or turns as it focuses entirely on solo basic footwork.
